meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 的机器人可以绑到你的个人微信账号上。别人给该微信号发消息，Claude 就能接收并回复；通过扫码登录，无需 API 密钥。
howto.when: 扫码登录并完成首次接线后，当其他微信账号向被绑定的微信号发送消息时触发。

say.text: 怎么扫码登录微信机器人？
say.note: 引导你查看日志中的二维码。

say.text: 把微信收到的消息交给 Claude 回复

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw's bot can be linked to your personal WeChat account. Messages sent to that WeChat number are received and replied to by Claude; login via QR scan, no API key required.
howto.when_en: Triggered after QR login and initial wiring, when another WeChat account sends a message to the linked WeChat number.

say_en.text: How do I scan QR to log in the WeChat bot?
say_en.note: Points you to the QR in the logs.

say_en.text: Let Claude reply to messages received on WeChat
say_en.note: After wiring, messages go to the agent.
